companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué tal? What's small and—wait, a leaf. Five more minutes. Your attention span? Incredible. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! How are you? What's small and—wait, a leaf. Five more minutes. Your attention span? Incredible. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal reluctance. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly merely changes which edge.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Looking isn't stopping, though. ¿Puedes detenerme? What's always moving and—wait, dust. Your attention: magnificent. Mine: elsewhere. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I'm looking! Looking isn't stopping, though. Can you stop me? What's always moving and—wait, dust. Your attention: magnificent. Mine: elsewhere. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, it does so while orbiting your elbow. A tiny firecracker files a complaint on its behalf.

lines.native: ¡Vale, me quedo aquí! Stopped. Incredible. What's a journey without—oh, dust. ¿Por dónde voy? Pick a direction; walking can wait. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Okay, I'll stay here! Stopped. Incredible. What's a journey without—oh, dust. Which way do I go? Pick a direction; walking can wait. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without it, having received no instructions.

lines.native: ¡Eso es inglés! ¿Por dónde voy? En español, por favor. A direction, not a riddle—wait, riddles can wait. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: That's English! Which way do I go? In Spanish, please. A direction, not a riddle—wait, riddles can wait. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains just outside your gaze, awaiting a direction with the patience of an unattended notification.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Perfect. ¿Qué hora es? What's early and—wait, don't finish that. Tenemos mucho tiempo. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Perfect. What time is it? What's early and—wait, don't finish that. We have lots of time. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, just outside your gaze. A tiny firecracker announces its arrival at the fountain, whose clock has retired without informing anyone.

lines.native: ¡Pero eso no me dice la hora! ¿Qué hora es? What's round and—wait, a spark. Just one more distraction. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: But that doesn't tell me the time! What time is it? What's round and—wait, a spark. Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick remains firmly in the corner of your vision, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: ¡La una, sí! Tienes razón. Pero tenemos tiempo. ¿Por qué tanta prisa? Just one more—what has hands and—never mind. Podemos empezar mañana. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: One o’clock, yes! You’re right. But we have time. Why such a hurry? Just one more—what has hands and—never mind. We can start tomorrow. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick sets off a tiny firecracker at the edge of your vision. It appears to be celebrating the postponement of something.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, sí! Eso es esperar, no empezar. ¿Cuándo quieres empezar de verdad? What's the rush—wait, shiny. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, yes! That's waiting, not starting. When do you really want to start? What's the rush—wait, shiny. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has mistaken your surrender for excellent time management.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! Entiendo. Tú ganas. ¿Qué empieza y nunca—wait, no. Está bien, empezamos ahora. My procrastination? Ruined. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! I understand. You win. What starts and never—wait, no. All right, we start now. My procrastination? Ruined. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops humming. A tiny firecracker expires with the quiet disappointment of a postponed meeting. He remains in the corner of your vision; apparently, even defeat has a preferred location.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Estoy bien aquí. Can I have five more minutes? What has legs but—ooh, a moth. ♪ La fuente canta. ♪
lines.translation: Hello! I'm fine here. Can I have five more minutes? What has legs but—ooh, a moth. ♪ The fountain sings. ♪
lines.narrative: At the Market Entrance, Flick joins your party by sitting down. A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Looking directly at it proves unhelpful.

lines.native: ¡Qué pena! That was English and a refusal; I need a Spanish number for my minutes. ¿Cuánto tiempo me das? Tengo sueño. ♪ La fuente canta. ♪
lines.translation: What a shame! That was English and a refusal; I need a Spanish number for my minutes. How much time do you give me? I'm sleepy. ♪ The fountain sings. ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your boot. Flick remains seated in the corner of your vision, defending a break that has not been approved.

lines.native: ¡Dos minutos, perfecto! Ya no queda tiempo. ¿Y ahora? What gets me moving? A riddle! Actually, five more— ♪ La fuente canta. ♪
lines.translation: Two minutes, perfect! There’s no time left. And now? What gets me moving? A riddle! Actually, five more— ♪ The fountain sings. ♪
lines.narrative: Flick accepts your two minutes. They expire while it searches for somewhere to put them. A tiny firecracker pops beside the path; Flick remains beside the wrong path.

lines.native: ¡Sí, vamos! Pero estoy aquí… ahora allí. You got me moving! What travels with—ooh, wings. ¿Tú vienes conmigo? ♪ La fuente canta. ♪
lines.translation: Yes, let's go! But I'm here… now there. You got me moving! What travels with—ooh, wings. Are you coming with me? ♪ The fountain sings. ♪
lines.narrative: Flick follows a passing moth into the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces that this was apparently the route all along.

lines.native: ¡Juntos, sí! Vienes conmigo. ¡Muy bien! We're a team now. What has two friends and—ooh, leaf. ♪ La fuente canta. ♪
lines.translation: Together, yes! You're coming with me. Very good! We're a team now. What has two friends and—ooh, leaf. ♪ The fountain sings. ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already at the edge of your vision, following a leaf with no apparent qualifications to lead.
